latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Generator Free Credits.

- Generate 30-second AI promo videos from text or images using 100 free credits (no paid plan required).
- Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, or PNG files up to 200MB for video creation; other common formats also supported.
- Credits are valid for 7 days and reset monthly; balances and export status available via simple commands.
- Automatic backend connection/authentication; minimal setup required.
- Error handling for expired tokens, no credits, large/unsupported files, and subscription limitations.
- Ideal for content creators and marketers to try AI video generation with a fast cloud workflow.
